name: Jan van Dijk
bio:
Jan's journey into motorsport began later in life, after a decade working as a general mechanic. A chance encounter with a Formula 3 team during a local racing event sparked his interest, leading him to pursue specialized training in precision machining. He's a meticulous worker, driven by the pursuit of perfection in every component he crafts. While relatively new to the high-pressure environment of professional racing, Jan's adaptability and willingness to learn make him a valuable asset, and he brings a fresh perspective to problem-solving.

He is eager to hone his skills under experienced engineers, and aims to master the latest CNC technologies used in modern race car manufacturing. He's a firm believer in the importance of collaboration and clear communication, and is actively working to improve his teamworking skills. Jan dreams of one day contributing to a championship-winning team, his name etched on the side of a successful machine.

physical.description: A stocky man with kind eyes and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches.
Has a habit of humming classical music while working.
Organizes his tools meticulously, often reorganizing them if interrupted.
